    ROW(
        id,
        name,
        revision,
        archived,
        legal_name,
        country_code,
        tax_id,
        registration_id,
        legal_address,
        roles,
        contacts,
        kpp,
        logist
    )::public.counterparty_v5,
    lower(name) COLLATE "C" AS sort_key
FROM counterparties
WHERE organization_id = $1::UUID

ORDER BY lower(name) COLLATE "C" ASC, id ASC
LIMIT $3::INTEGER;

WHERE organization_id = $1::UUID
  AND (COALESCE(country_code, '') = ANY($2::TEXT[]))
  AND (archived = ANY($3::BOOLEAN[]))
GROUP BY registry_value.value COLLATE "C"
ORDER BY registry_value.value COLLATE "C"
LIMIT $4::INTEGER;
